newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shaw Brothers to hold 34 pct of TVB.
newsitem.headline: Shaw Brothers to hold 34 pct of TVB.

text.p: Shaw Brothers (Hong Kong) Ltd said on Monday that it and associated parties would hold about 34.33 percent of Television Broadcasts Ltd following a deal in which Pearson Plc sold its 10 percent stake.
In a deal announced on Friday, Shaw Brothers agreed to buy 21.0 million TVB shares from Pearson at HK$33.25 per share.
The Shaw Foundation Hong Kong Ltd, an associate of the company, also agreed to acquire 21.0 million shares at HK$33.25.
"The board of directors considers that this purchase will enable the company to consolidate its position as a controlling shareholder of TVB," Shaw Brothers said in a statement.
It said the purchase would be funded partly by internal resouces and partly by bank borrowings.
TVB shares closed at HK$34.00 on Friday.
